quests.title: Short Delivery, Coledale
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The Coledale order has been two cartons light every week since the week of the show and the invoice says otherwise every time. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Coledale
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $107 owing to Coledale and it is not going to walk in here itself. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: $107, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Coledale Run
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. I do the Coledale run at twenty past four and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Wombarra
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Coledale
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I have got a esky of warm cans in the back of the van and the Coledale shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Coledale
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. Three of the Coledale regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $63 down on those days. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$63, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Coledale
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Everything Coledale sells comes off a floor at Wombarra, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Quakers Hill
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Quakers Hill on a wet Monday and one of them has a note from his mother. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Quakers Hill
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. We found a twelfth, which means the Quakers Hill club now owes the association $29 it had budgeted on not owing. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: $29 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Quakers Hill Canteen
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The canteen at Quakers Hill does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at first light. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Quakers Hill
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Somebody walked off with the float from the Quakers Hill canteen at about first light during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$60, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Quakers Hill
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The sprinkler line under the Quakers Hill outfield has been leaking since a wet Monday and the wet patch has started to move. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Quakers Hill
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at Marayong, and Quakers Hill has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.title: The Creek Behind Otford
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Otford since the long weekend and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.title: Willow Removal, Otford
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. They have agreed to a clean-up at Otford, which is wonderful, except the grant is $47 short and closes on the long weekend. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: $47, and I do not care whose pocket
the form needs the number today

quests.title: Sandbags, Otford
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. We had 41 sandbags in the Otford shed on the long weekend and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the yards backing onto the reserve
anywhere they have obviously been used

quests.title: The Low Crossing, Otford
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. People keep driving the low crossing at Otford at ten past five with the water over the sign, and one of them is going to be the one. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: you will be standing out there a while
the ones who argue with the barrier

quests.title: Under the House, Otford
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The water came through my place at Otford on the long weekend and the assessor wants photographs of things I have already thrown out. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: round the side, where the pile is
the high-water mark on the brick
that is the whole claim, that mark

quests.title: Upstream, Otford
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Whatever is happening to Otford starts upstream at Stanwell Park, and there are people up there who have been saying so for years. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: go up and find them
I want to hear it from someone who is not me
